2.3.29 Report.PageFooter
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.PageFooter element specifies a footer that is rendered at the bottom of each rendered
Page of a Report. This element is optional. This element is of type PageHeaderFooter.
Following is the parent element of the Report.PageFooter element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.PageFooter element.
 <xsd:element name="PageFooter" type="PageHeaderFooterType" minOccurs="0" />
